title: Nvidia’s $500B Infrastructure Deal: Wall Street Vote of Confidence or Another Circular Deal for the AI Bubble?
excerpt: Wall Street's biggest financial juggernauts just inked a jaw-dropping infrastructure deal with Nvidia, and the question of whether this signals a genuine rev...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • Wall Street's $500 billion private capital commitment to Nvidia's AI infrastructure signals institutional confidence in AI as a proven, serious investment capable of ROI.

  • AI compute is emerging as a futures-market commodity, shifting the technology from an experiment into a legitimate, investable asset class.

  • Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) really captured the hearts and investment dollars of some of the biggest titans on Wall Street. With Jensen Huang's GPU empire landing around $500 billion worth of private capital to fund the great AI infrastructure buildout, questions linger as to whether this jaw-droppingly massive deal adds to the risk profile while bringing greater circularity into the financial sector or if it's a huge vote of confidence from some of the biggest and most legendary financial heavyweight champs on the market.

Undoubtedly, it's easy to dismiss the $500 infrastructure deal as just more air for an already sizeable AI bubble that will go bust at some point down the road. But, at the same time, it's hard to dismiss such industry juggernauts whose expertise spans alternative asset management, private equity, public markets, and investment banking.

Sure, some financial heavyweights made mistakes in the past. The Great Financial Crisis showed that big banks can go down with outsized bets in all the wrong places. But, at the same time, things are vastly different this time around. And these financial giants know how to do their homework.

Why I'm treating the big bets as a vote of confidence in this revolution

They know risk management better than most anyone else, and with their confidence and the massive checks being inked by the hyperscalers, I do lean on the side of the latest $500 billion infrastructure deal being a massive vote of confidence, rather than something to hit the panic button over as the AI revolution starts to capture more of the investment dollars of other industries.

Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

What's more, the financial giants, including investment banking heavyweight Goldman Sachs (NYSE:GS), already have a grasp of the kind of value that AI can bring to the table.

Indeed, AI is already a significant part of the firm, and with so many big banks utilizing the technology, I think a pretty strong argument could be made that the financial giants are already becoming aware of the kinds of ROI that the technology can provide.

快速阅读

  • 华尔街对 Nvidia 人工智能基础设施的 5000 亿美元私人资本承诺标志着机构对人工智能的信心，认为人工智能是一项经过验证、能够带来投资回报的认真投资。
  • 人工智能计算正在成为一种期货市场商品，使该技术从实验转变为合法的、可投资的资产类别。
  • 不要等待：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚透露了他最喜欢的 10 只人工智能股票。 立即免费查看完整列表。

英伟达（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）确实俘获了华尔街一些最大巨头的心并吸引了他们的投资。 随着黄仁勋的 GPU 帝国获得价值约 5000 亿美元的私人资本来资助大规模的人工智能基础设施建设，人们仍然存在这样的疑问：这笔令人瞠目结舌的巨额交易是否会增加风险状况，同时为金融业带来更大的循环性，或者这是否是市场上一些最大、最具传奇色彩的金融重量级冠军投下的一张巨大的信任票。

毫无疑问，人们很容易将 500 美元的基础设施交易视为只是为已经相当大的人工智能泡沫注入更多空气，而该泡沫将在未来的某个时刻破裂。 但与此同时，我们很难忽视这些行业巨头，他们的专业知识涵盖另类资产管理、私募股权、公开市场和投资银行业务。

当然，一些金融巨头过去也犯过错误。 金融危机表明，大银行可能因为在错误的地方进行过大的押注而倒闭。 但与此同时，这一次情况却大不相同。 而这些金融巨头也知道如何做足功课。

为什么我将大赌注视为对这场革命的信任票

他们比大多数人都更了解风险管理，而且凭借他们的信心和超大规模企业签署的巨额支票，我确实认为最新的 5000 亿美元基础设施交易是一次大规模的信任投票，而不是随着人工智能革命开始吸引更多其他行业的投资资金而引发恐慌。

不要等待：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚透露了他最喜欢的 10 只人工智能股票。 立即免费查看完整列表。

更重要的是，包括投资银行重量级高盛（NYSE：GS）在内的金融巨头已经掌握了人工智能可以带来的价值。

事实上，人工智能已经是公司的重要组成部分，而且随着如此多的大银行使用这项技术，我认为可以提出一个非常有力的论据，即金融巨头已经开始意识到该技术可以提供的投资回报率。
